tips: Spotify: the only allowed click is a DOUBLE click on a song title. Step 1: `url "spotify:search:<query>"` (spaces as %20) — it already searches, do not click the search field. Step 2: `click "<song title> in the search results" double` (plays it). Single clicks, icons, hearts and checkmarks are blocked.

Spotify AppleScript (control/read only, not for starting a new song): `tell application "Spotify" to pause` / `next track`; check with `get player state` (expect "playing") and `get name of current track`.

YouTube: `url "https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=<words+joined+by+plus>"`, then press the first video link whose title fits the goal (skip ads, Shorts, channels and playlists). On a YouTube page `/` focuses search and `k` plays/pauses.
A playing video's page URL has `watch?v=` and the window title ends with "- YouTube"; done only after that page shows.
Search on the page: press the site's own search box (combobox/textfield "Search"), type the query, press return, then open a video link. Never type the search into the browser address bar.

Shopping: search on the site's own search box. On the results list, press the inline `button "Add ..."` whose label contains "to cart" on the FIRST product that is not "Out of stock"/"Sold out"/"Choose options". Labels read "Add <item name> to cart" — verify with `expect appears "to cart"` or the cart-count link (`appears "1 item"`).

If a result is out of stock or needs options, press the NEXT product's inline Add button. Never press Checkout/Buy it now/Place order; never remove items. Done when the cart count goes up or an "added to cart" confirmation shows.

Apple Maps: press the search field, type the destination, `keys return`, press the matching result, then press "Directions" (or `url "maps://?daddr=<destination>"` opens the directions panel directly).

The window title stays "Maps" — do NOT expect title~"Directions". After pressing Directions, the panel shows route cards as text like "21 min, 2:25 ETA"; pick the mode with `radio "Drive"` (car), "Walk" or "Transit", then press a route card or "Go".
Done when a route with a travel time shows (text like "N min, ETA").

Slack: cmd+k opens the quick switcher (channels, people). To set a status: press your profile picture button, then "Update your status" (or "Set a status"), type the status text, press "Save". Never post a message unless the user asked to send one (that needs `confirm`).
Reminders: press the list's row in the sidebar if the goal names a list; `keys cmd+n` adds a new reminder to the selected list.
Type the title with the time in natural language ("Call mom at 5pm"), then `keys return`; or after the title set the time via the reminder's info (i) button -> date/time.
Never create a second reminder for the same request: after return, check the row (and its time) instead of pressing cmd+n again.
Never edit, complete or delete existing reminders.
Calendar: `keys cmd+n` opens a quick event field; type a natural-language event like "Lunch with Sam tomorrow at 3pm", then `keys return` (Calendar parses the date and time).
Done when the new event shows with that title and time; add location or end time in the event's detail popover only if asked.
When the details are on screen (an email or page), copy title, date and time exactly from the observation; if the date or time is not shown, `ask`.

Wallpaper from a file: `script applescript """tell application "System Events" to tell every desktop to set picture to POSIX file "<absolute path>""""` (the user confirms). Check with `tell application "System Events" to get picture of desktop 1`.
Wallpaper settings pane: `url "x-apple.systempreferences:com.apple.Wallpaper-Settings.extension"`.

Find a file: `skill find_file query="<name words>"`, or `script applescript """tell application "Finder" to get POSIX path of (every file of entire contents of folder (POSIX file "<folder>") whose name contains "<word>") as alias list"""` for a known folder.

Rename in Finder: `skill open_folder path=<folder>`, press the file's row, `keys return` (edit name), `skill type_text text="<new name with the same extension>"`, `keys return`; then expect `appears "<new name>"`. Keep the extension unless the user changes it.

System Settings panes open directly: `url "x-apple.systempreferences:com.apple.<pane id>"` (e.g. com.apple.Wallpaper-Settings.extension, com.apple.Displays-Settings.extension, com.apple.ControlCenter-Settings.extension, com.apple.Desktop-Settings.extension for Desktop & Dock). In a pane, press the switch/popup itself, not its sidebar row.
Dictionary app: `url "dict://<word>"` opens the word's entry; done when the window title shows the word.
Weather / Stocks apps: open the app, focus its search field (press `searchfield`, or `keys cmd+f`), type the city or ticker, press the best matching result row; done when its card shows the name.
Clock: open "Clock", then press the Timers tab (radio/tab "Timers").
The text field under the duration wheels is the timer LABEL: never type the duration there.
New timer: wheels are hours, minutes, seconds; press the minutes wheel, type the minutes, check the wheel shows them, then press button "Start".
A running timer's row has "Pause" ("Resume" when paused); the detail pane has "Cancel". Never touch the wheels to pause, resume or cancel.
Pause/resume/cancel: press that button ONCE, then `done`; a second press undoes it.
Notes: `keys cmd+n` creates a new note and focuses its body (textarea).
Type into the note body; the first line becomes the note's title, so type the title, `keys return`, then the text.
Never edit or delete an existing note; always start with cmd+n.

Gmail reply: if a reply box (textarea "Message Body") is already open or focused, do NOT press Reply — type straight into it. Otherwise press "Reply" once; Gmail then focuses the reply body, so type with `skill type_text text="..."`. Never press Reply again after typing, and never type into a button.
Once the reply text is typed the draft is finished: `done` (or `confirm` first if the user asked to send). Always `confirm` before pressing Send.
Messages: `keys cmd+n` starts a new message; type the recipient into the "To:" field and `keys return`.
Then press the message field at the bottom and type the body without return.
`confirm "Send <body> to <name>?"` before `keys return`; never send without confirm.

"make/cut/trim this clip to N seconds" = change the clip's DURATION, never a razor cut. `keys shift+3` focuses the Timeline panel; `keys d` selects the clip at the playhead if nothing is selected; `keys cmd+r` opens Clip Speed/Duration; set the Duration field (press its ref from the new observation, or Tab from Speed) to e.g. 00:00:05:00 and press Return.
Edits are undoable — no confirm needed. Never open QuickTime, File > New, or another app; the clip is in the open sequence.

Browsers: if the goal names a browser, `open "<Browser>"` first, then `keys cmd+l`, `skill type_text text="<url or query>"`, `keys return` so the page loads in that browser's current tab; `keys cmd+f` finds text on the page. Prefer a site's own search URL over clicking through its home page.

Search-then-act: 1) go straight to the app's/site's search (URL scheme or search URL; else cmd+f / cmd+l / `/`), 2) type the query from the goal and press return, 3) press the result that best matches the goal words (skip ads and "Sponsored"), 4) press the action itself (Play, Add to Cart, Directions), 5) `done` only after the observation shows the end state (playing, added, route shown).
